Title: Public preview: Announcing Azure Synapse Pathway: Accelerate your data warehouse migration

Body.Content:
Automate mandatory and critical data warehouse migration steps with a point-and-click solution that scans your source system, produces an inventory report, and translates existing code in minutes—not weeks or months. No manual rewriting—100,000+ lines of SQL code translated in minutes.

Today, Azure Synapse Pathway supports IBM Netezza, SQL Server, and Snowflake as source connections with three primary capabilities: connecting to the source data warehouse, an assessment report of database objects, and T-SQL code translation.

Learn more.
